practiceProblems.title: Student Marks Analyzer
practiceProblems.statement: Read marks of N students for one subject and print the highest, lowest and average mark.
practiceProblems.hint: Track a running max, min and sum in a single loop over the array.

practiceProblems.title: Number Frequency Counter
practiceProblems.statement: Given an array of integers, count how many times each distinct number appears.
practiceProblems.hint: A std::map<int,int> can accumulate counts keyed by the number itself.

practiceProblems.title: Array Statistics
practiceProblems.statement: Compute the sum, average, maximum and minimum of an array without using STL algorithms.
practiceProblems.hint: Initialize max and min to the first element, then update them while scanning.

practiceProblems.title: String Analyzer
practiceProblems.statement: Given a sentence, count vowels, consonants, digits and spaces.
practiceProblems.hint: Loop through each character and classify it with isalpha, isdigit and a vowel check.

practiceProblems.title: Matrix Calculator
practiceProblems.statement: Read two 2x2 matrices and print their sum and product.
practiceProblems.hint: Matrix multiplication: result[i][j] is the dot product of row i of A and column j of B.

practiceProblems.title: Bank Transaction Analyzer
practiceProblems.statement: Given a list of deposits (positive) and withdrawals (negative), compute the final balance and the largest single transaction.
practiceProblems.hint: Track balance by adding each transaction, and largest by comparing absolute values.

practiceProblems.title: Employee Salary Calculator
practiceProblems.statement: Calculate net salary for multiple employees given basic pay, allowances and deductions.
practiceProblems.hint: Net = basic + allowances - deductions. Repeat for each employee using a loop.

practiceProblems.title: Inventory Calculator
practiceProblems.statement: Given item quantities and unit prices, calculate the total value of inventory.
practiceProblems.hint: Multiply quantity by price for each item and accumulate the total.

practiceProblems.title: Contact Search System
practiceProblems.statement: Store a list of names and phone numbers, then search for a name using binary search after sorting.
practiceProblems.hint: Sort the array first, then apply binary search since it requires sorted data.

practiceProblems.title: Mini Library System
practiceProblems.statement: Track books with copies available; issuing reduces copies, returning increases them, and copies can never go negative or exceed the original stock.
practiceProblems.input: book = "C++ Basics", copies = 3, issue x2, return x1
practiceProblems.hint: Guard both directions: don't issue if copies == 0, and don't return above the original total.

practiceProblems.title: Palindrome Checker
practiceProblems.statement: Read a word and check whether it reads the same forwards and backwards.
practiceProblems.hint: Compare characters from both ends moving toward the middle.

practiceProblems.title: Matrix Transpose
practiceProblems.statement: Read an N x M matrix and print its transpose.
practiceProblems.hint: The transpose swaps rows and columns: result[j][i] = matrix[i][j].
